Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: a. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b. The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Project Associate-I (PA): Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Agartala Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date. Please refer to the official notification for any specific last date for sending scanned copies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is a consolidated amount of Rs. 37,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate-I (PA) post, candidates must have a Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves evaluation based on national-level examinations like CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, or other examinations conducted by central government departments and their agencies.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at the National Institute of Technology Agartala, Agartala, Tripura, 799046.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with one post for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and one post for Project Associate-I (PA).

faq.question: Q8. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NIT Agartala?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Institute of Technology Agartala is www.nita.ac.in.
